sections.name: File setup, Basis
sections.title: Imports and date basis choices
sections.what: Loads the React hooks, the 3D canvas, network types, saved view helpers and styling, and defines the four date basis choices.
sections.why: Likely reason: the page needs these pieces before it can show anything.

sections.name: readable
sections.title: Readable label helper
sections.what: Turns joined words into spaced words and adds a space between numbers and unit words, changing only what is displayed.
sections.why: Likely reason: the source names are often joined, so this makes them easier to read without altering the data.
sections.watch_out: The pattern matches letters and digits, so an identifier containing those patterns will display differently from its stored value.

sections.name: NetworkProgrammeView (part 1)
sections.title: Page state, schedule data and layout
sections.what: Keeps the page's choices in memory, such as the chosen view, selected item, date, date basis and preview mode, and saves them per job. It works out the schedule's start and end, the activities running on the chosen date, and the 3D items linked to the chosen activity. It then draws the header, the view buttons, the 3D canvas with its caption, and the tab buttons for the side panel.
sections.why: Likely reason: many choices depend on each other, so they are computed together from one set of data.
sections.watch_out: The header is labelled UNRELEASED and says this is source interpretation, so the view must not be read as an approved result.

sections.name: NetworkProgrammeView (part 2)
sections.title: Inspector tabs and playback controls
sections.what: Fills the side panel for the open tab: scope details and source links, a paged activity list, source checks per PI, station inventory, relationship explanations and ALICE records. The footer holds start, play, pause and completed preview buttons and a picker for the date basis.
sections.why: Likely reason: each kind of evidence has its own tab, so schedule logic, physical connections and inventory are kept apart.
sections.watch_out: Some warning text was cut off in the packet, so its full wording could not be checked here.

summary: The page that hosts the networked programme view and provides a helper that makes labels easier to read.
purpose: Presents the programme network with the 3D canvas and keeps the viewer's saved settings.
why: Likely reason: the label helper is display-only, so the stored names and IDs are never changed.
how: Defines the date basis choices. The readable helper adds spaces inside camel-case words and before unit words like metres or feet. The main component then hosts the 3D canvas, reads saved viewer state, and passes the chosen date basis down.
inputs: The programme network, the programme scene, the saved viewer state, and the user's date basis and selection choices.
outputs: The rendered page and updated viewer state when settings change.
risks: The label helper uses pattern rules, so an unusual identifier could be split in a misleading way on screen. Only 2 of 4 sections were visible, so the main logic is not fully known.
debug: If labels look odd, check the two pattern rules in the readable helper first. If a saved view does not come back, check the viewer state read and write helpers.
